question: After the session-accessor boundary repair, should this PR require current-head Telegram/runtime proof before merge or be accepted on source and CI evidence alone?
rationale: This external PR changes durable session-state recovery and visible delivery behavior, and the current proof is narrative plus tests rather than an observable current-head artifact.

options.title: Require proof after repair
options.body: Hold merge until the boundary violation is fixed and a redacted terminal/log artifact or Telegram Desktop recording shows stale-row recovery and follow-up delivery on the current head.

options.title: Accept source-only validation
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly override the real-behavior proof gate after the boundary repair if they accept the session-state risk from tests and source inspection.

options.title: Pause behind the older PR
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers choose the older stale-row PR as the canonical fix path after resolving its dirty/conflicting state.

recommendation.title: Require proof after repair
recommendation.body: Hold merge until the boundary violation is fixed and a redacted terminal/log artifact or Telegram Desktop recording shows stale-row recovery and follow-up delivery on the current head.

likelyOwner.reason: The open decision centers on the session-accessor storage boundary and durable session-state migration risk.
